newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thailand's Bangchak cuts runs, delays turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Bangchak cuts runs, delays turnaround.

text.p: Thailand's Bangchak Petroleum Co's 120,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) refinery cut runs two weeks ago to 100,000 bpd, a refinery source said on Thursday.
The source also said that the maintenance turnaround of its 40,000 bpd crude distillation unit (CDU) has also been postponed from August to at least September or later.
The source said that weak refinery margins had led to the cut in refinery runs.
He said the refinery was uncertain when it would return to full capacity, but it would probably be when gasoil prices improve.
